summary: Security review confirms Sprint 3 has no new search, filter, or sort input surface to assess because the requested feature is not implemented.

messages.content: Security cannot complete Sprint 3 feature review: no query parsing or UI controls for search/filter/sort exist. When implemented, whitelist sort fields/directions and parameterize search/status values while retaining the authenticated user_id predicate.

blockers: Search, filtering, and sorting are absent from both server.py and static/index.html.
decisions: Current task queries remain user-scoped and use a fixed ORDER BY id DESC; no dynamic SQL ordering or query-input handling has been added.
Existing authentication regression suite passes (5 tests).
